body:
Add two positive source programs that exercise Boolean precedence, comparisons, postconditions and a Core/2 Await guard through the actual public Rust checker. Freeze and compare each complete 21-node Program and both JSON and human checker streams.

Validation: one aggregate Rust test passes; all four public checker processes exit 0 and match their complete expected streams. Both API Program values match the hand-derived frozen fixtures. All 911 recorded source pins match commit 27b3b12c. Expectations explicitly disclose implementation-source exposure; no production change or RED defect is claimed.

Draft stacked on #249. Independent source/result review is pending. These source admission and serialization checks do not establish runtime truth, financial semantics, compiler artifacts, proofs, ledger acceptance or closure of the 27-constructor scope.
title: Cover positive Boolean programs through public Core checking
